title: A Textbook Example of a Bow Shock in the Merging Galaxy Cluster 1E 0657-56

evidence.locator: Sect. 4.1: the X-ray brightness profile in a sector centred on the bullet's centre of curvature, along its apparent motion, is fitted with gas components that are spherically symmetric around their centres; the density jump at the shock is 3.2 +/- 0.8. A large inclination of the velocity from the sky plane would smear the sharp brightness edges; with the subcluster's line-of-sight velocity (Barrena et al.) the deviation from the sky plane is 10 to 15 degrees.
